name: LethAL R136 ArmC Probe
brief: R136 arm C: does Delete(true) run OnDelete when the record was never Get/Find'd, only its primary key assigned?
description: Throwaway probe, not for production use. Measures whether `Rec."No." := X; Rec.Delete(true);` (no preceding Get/Find) successfully deletes the row and runs OnDelete, the exact shape of codeunit 79314 "Data Flag Ops".DeleteWithTrigger in fixtures/sandbox-data.
